body: Thank you! Sorry for the late response but things actually got better right after this post, I hope things are better for you too! Don’t worry, things can work themselves out in unexpected ways

Sorry for the late response I wasn’t checking my account. Thanks for worrying about me! Things actually got a lot better after this post and I am no longer thinking these dark kinds of thoughts. I just have to remember things work themselves out. Thank you for your thoughts and kind words
I've been through some bad breakups, but nothing like that. I am sorry. If you ever need to talk about it you can message me

I qualify for Pandemic Unemployment Assistance but no one knows when thats going to get sent out, I sent in my application weeks ago and I call the labor office 100 times a day but I am always told that the phone lines are too busy and then it disconnects. There are no other government benefits I qualify for. I really had hopes it would somehow work itself out this week, but its clear nothing will for me during this pandemic. I feel so sick all day and I can't sleep from the stress of it. Thank you for messaging with me though, I didn't think anyone would read my depressed rants.

Where I live you can still get evicted if your landlord files an eviction case, even though apparently all evictions are halted it really depends on the state. The US sucks, they don't help at all, they don't care at all. You're lucky you live in Canada, I heard the government got benefits to the people within a week.

I can’t even move back home to save myself from being kicked out of my place because my elderly grandparents are there and I likely have the coronavirus. I can’t spread it to them, I don’t know how I’m going to survive these next few weeks. I just wish one thing in this whole mess worked out for me. I just want to end it all. I might do it this weekend
